text: Mobile app development involves creating software for smartphones and tablets. One important idea is responsive design, which means the app works well on different screen sizes. Developers must also choose between native and cross-platform approaches. Native apps are built for one system, like Android or iOS, and often perform better. Cross-platform apps work on several systems at once, saving time and money. After development, apps are usually published on app stores, such as Google Play or the App Store. Finally, performance matters a lot. A fast, smooth app keeps users happy, while a slow one is quickly deleted.
